xml_structure: <e-flexbox configuration-id="Header"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Utility bar"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Utility contacts"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Util phone"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Util email"></e-paragraph><e-paragraph configuration-id="Util location"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-paragraph configuration-id="Util tagline"></e-paragraph></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Navigation"><e-image configuration-id="Logo"></e-image><e-flexbox configuration-id="Menu"><e-flexbox configuration-id="Nav Home"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Nav Home label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="Nav Home bar"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Nav About Us"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Nav About Us label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="Nav About Us bar"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Nav Brands"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Nav Brands label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="Nav Brands bar"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Nav Products"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Nav Products label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="Nav Products bar"></e-div-block></e-flexbox><e-flexbox configuration-id="Nav Contact Us"><e-paragraph configuration-id="Nav Contact Us label"></e-paragraph><e-div-block configuration-id="Nav Contact Us bar"></e-div-block></e-flexbox></e-flexbox><e-button configuration-id="Header CTA"></e-button></e-flexbox></e-flexbox>

Util tagline.paragraph: Premium supplies for hotels, restaurants & cafés

style.Header: flex-direction: column; padding: 0px; gap: 0px; position: sticky; top: 0px; z-index: 50; background: #FFFFFF;
style.Utility bar: background: var(--on-navy-deep); padding: 11px 100px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; @media(--tablet){ padding: 10px 40px; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 9px 20px; justify-content: center; }
style.Util phone: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
style.Util email: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
style.Util location: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Util tagline: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: var(--on-gold-soft); @media(--mobile){ display: none; }
style.Navigation: min-height: 96px; padding: 12px 100px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 24px; border-width: 0px 0px 1px 0px; border-style: solid; border-color: #E6E0D6; background: #FFFFFF; @media(--tablet){ padding: 14px 40px; flex-wrap: wrap; } @media(--mobile){ padding: 14px 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
style.Menu: padding: 0px; width: auto; gap: 44px; align-items: flex-start; @media(--tablet){ order: 3; width: 100%; justify-content: center; gap: 28px; } @media(--mobile){ order: 3; width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; gap: 6px; }
style.Nav Home: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Nav Home label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #16213A; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }
style.Nav Home bar: width: 22px; min-width: 22px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: transparent;
style.Nav About Us: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Nav About Us label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #16213A; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }
style.Nav About Us bar: width: 22px; min-width: 22px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: transparent;
style.Nav Brands: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Nav Brands label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #16213A; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }
style.Nav Brands bar: width: 22px; min-width: 22px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: transparent;
style.Nav Products: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Nav Products label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #16213A; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }
style.Nav Products bar: width: 22px; min-width: 22px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: transparent;
style.Nav Contact Us: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0px; width: auto;
style.Nav Contact Us label: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0B2F62; transition: color 0.3s; &:hover{ color: #C9962E; } @media(--mobile){ font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.6px; }
style.Nav Contact Us bar: width: 22px; min-width: 22px; height: 2px; padding: 0px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #A5740B 0%, #DEAF57 25%, #F1C96A 50%, #BE8826 75%, #A5740B 100%);
